title: BBGR lens thickness comparison (Ct / Et)
notes: Plus lenses: center thickness (Ct), blank diameter assumption 65 mm per chart note
Minus lenses: edge thickness (Et), blank diameter assumption 70 mm per chart note

Do NOT quote as exact promise for client frame without calculation
